page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 virtual CPUs, which correspond to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, alongside 32.0 GB of system memory and a bundled 959 GB local SSD. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.i2g.2xlarge generally sits in the lower performance tiers for compute-heavy tasks. Both single-core and multi-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the bottom 25% category. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read performance for both small and large blocks, though large block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptography and database operations, including Redis SET operations, also rank in the bottom 25%. For LLM inference, the instance achieves average speeds with small 135M models but drops to poor performance with medium 7B models.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.i2g.2xlarge is its modest CPU and memory performance relative to its substantial 959 GB local SSD storage. While it offers dedicated CPU allocation and a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, its processing capabilities are limited for compute-intensive tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance is best utilized for workloads that require significant local storage capacity rather than high-speed processing. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, lightweight database hosting, local file caching, and basic web serving where storage volume is prioritized over raw computational throughput.
